description: Standing jobs: one job owned by the calling wallet in detail: schedule, runs completed, succeeded, failed and skipped, the last result summary, recent failures with error codes, recent runs with delivery outcomes, the next run, and one full signed run report (the latest, or run_index). Past run records stay readable after the job ends. POST /api/schedule-status. Standing jobs check and report: they run read-and-report Wever tools only and never move money, place orders or change state. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Every call carries X-Wever-Wallet-Proof bound to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route; a paid call adds Payment-Signature from the same wallet. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/standing-jobs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/standing-jobs/.

job_id.description: Standing job identifier returned at creation.

run_index.description: Optional run number to return in full. Defaults to the latest run.
